assertions.assertion: The appeal is for the PR-204 denial
CPT 93226 is the 48-hour Holter monitoring study
The payer letter states the service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The clinical indication documents a history of recurrent palpitations consistent with supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1)
The diagnosis code I47.1 is used
The clinical indication documents episodes of dizziness (R42)
The diagnosis code R42 is used
The clinical indication documents a recent event of syncope (R55)
The diagnosis code R55 is used
The order states the 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to correlate these symptomatic episodes with potential arrhythmic activity and guide further management
